claim.quote: The overall results may be interpreted as an upper limit on the absolute value of the neutron EDM of |d_n| < 2.9 x 10^{-26} e cm (90% CL).

date.note: arXiv v1 submission date; the journal version is Phys. Rev. Lett. 97, 131801 (2006).

name: An Improved Experimental Limit on the Electric Dipole Moment of the Neutron

summary.plain: An experiment at the Institut Laue-Langevin in Grenoble found no electric dipole moment of the neutron and set an upper limit of 2.9 x 10^-26 electron charge times centimetre at 90 per cent confidence.
summary.technical: ILL search for the neutron EDM using stored ultracold neutrons and a cohabiting atomic-mercury magnetometer, two independent analyses: |d_n| < 2.9 x 10^-26 e cm (90% CL).

title: An Improved Experimental Limit on the Electric Dipole Moment of the Neutron
why_it_matters: The abstract states that spurious signals from magnetic-field fluctuations were reduced to insignificance by the cohabiting mercury magnetometer and that geometric-phase false EDMs were carefully studied.
